$comment: Read-only Postgres for a worktree's dev database (stdlib Python, stdio, runs the psql CLI). Config lives only in the personal .agents/postgres.local.json of each project; the server refuses a role that is not read-only. {repo} is this checkout, filled in at sync, so moving the repo needs a re-sync. Needs python3 and psql (12 or newer) on the agent's PATH. Codex pre-approves schema, query and explain; a future tool still prompts. No secrets.
